operation_title: This method updates an existing subscription. This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.2-1.

request_body.description: It contains the list of changes to be made to the profile of the NF Instance, according to the JSON PATCH format specified in IETF RFC 6902 [13].

notes: No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.2-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.2-3.

constraints.statement: The request body shall contain one or more PatchItem elements (cardinality 1..N).
The PATCH request shall not include any query parameters.
The operation shall support a 200 OK response with a SubscriptionData body.
The operation shall support a 204 No Content response.
The resource URI shall include the subscriptionID path variable.
If a 200 OK response is returned, the response body shall be of type SubscriptionData.
If reqNotifEvents is present in SubscriptionData, it shall contain one or more NotificationEventType values.
If reqNfType is present in SubscriptionData, its value shall be one of the NFType enumeration values.
If notifCondition.monitoredAttributes is present, it shall contain one or more string values.
If notifCondition.unmonitoredAttributes is present, it shall contain one or more string values.
subscriptionId in SubscriptionData is read-only and shall not be supplied as an updatable field in the subscription profile.
